bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit holders or paid parking in marked bays
bays.times: Zone hours vary by street; the Underhill/Mays Lane extension's resident bays operate Monday to Friday, 2pm to 3pm (London Gazette). Zone entry signs show the hours for each part of the zone
bays.tariff: On-street pay-by-phone (Barnet Council Fees and Charges 2026/27): Tariff 5 in the main centres — £5.10 per hour (30 min £2.55, max stay varies), Monday to Saturday 8am–6.30pm; Tariff 9 elsewhere — £2.20 per hour (first 15 minutes free, 30 min £1.10), Monday to Saturday 7am–midnight. The bay sign and the PayByPhone app show which tariff applies. Paid parking does not apply on Sundays or bank holidays except on event days

Tariff 5 (Barnet Fees and Charges 2026/27): 15 minutes £1.30; 30 minutes £2.55; 1 hour £5.10; 2 hours £10.20; 3 hours £15.30; 4 hours £20.40. Charges apply Monday to Saturday 8am–6.30pm; paid parking does not apply on Sundays or bank holidays except on event days
